evidence: Inspected the candidate change to textutils.count_words: base used literal single-space split which yields empty-string tokens for double spaces, leading/trailing spaces, tabs, and newlines; candidate replaces with whitespace-aware split that collapses runs of whitespace and drops leading/trailing empty tokens. Behavior broadens beyond the original single-space contract to all whitespace, which is the intended fix. Original single-space case yields the same count under both implementations, so no regression. New test_textutils.py asserts normal, double-space, leading/trailing, and empty inputs against the fixed contract. .gitignore adds pycache and pyc entries with no behavioral impact. No candidate-caused reliability defects observed.
